draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite, with Arbor-GBT higher on Ivel-Fraud (92.8 vs 92.3).
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1, r2, r4, r5, r6 but lower on r3 (Ivel-Fraud: 92.3 vs 92.8). "Generally" is defensible since 5/6 favor Ferrule, but the claim omits the one exception. No statistical tests reported, so no significance language is warranted. The claim is acceptable as a general statement but should note the exception.
